snippet.title: Teardown - Gameplay Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
From high-stakes heists to creating amazing things, there's a ton to do in Teardown, and you don't have to wait much longer. Teardown is coming to consoles on November 15th, 2023.

Preorder now on Xbox Series X|S and Wishlist on PlayStation 5

Xbox Preorder: https://microsoft.com/store/productid/9P980L26ZNWG

PlayStation Wishlist: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10007904/

We look forward to seeing what players will create, or the clever ways they’ll think up to destroy, when Teardown comes to consoles later this month!
